policy: Official picks use Hubáček gates: decorrelated model beats the de-vigged market by >= 2 pp, honest EV >= 2% (calibrated pre-decorrelation probability), and a per-bet-type confidence bar (20 pp moneyline, 10 pp baseball/soccer, 5 pp spread cover). Live thresholds live in web/hubacek_picks.py; per-league overrides (min_market_gap_pp, min_win_confidence_pp, min_ev_pct, ml_lo/ml_hi, allowed_sides, min_spread_cover_gap_pp, min_spread_confidence_pp) are stored here from walk-forward bet backtests.

mlb.note: MLB v2 walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_mlb_bets.py): raw model-market gap >= 6 pp (6.7 pp after 1.12x decorrelation), prices -200..+200. Opening-line ROI +35% (2024-2026, CLV +21.8%); closing-line floor -3.2%. Bets recorded in the morning sit between those brackets.

wnba.note: WNBA v2 walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_wnba_bets.py): pure margin model (sigma 12.58) cover probability vs the juice-implied break-even. At the opening spread a 10 pp gap returned +5.2% ROI (321 bets, all 3 open-odds seasons 2024-2026 positive) and an 8 pp gap +5.6% (405 bets, 4/4 seasons); consensus-close floor +1.6% at best book price (2018-2026). Live gate is 8 pp with a 5 pp confidence floor because morning bets are placed between the open and the close.

nhl.note: NHL v2 walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_nhl_bets.py): raw model-market gap >= 7 pp (7.8 pp after 1.12x decorrelation), prices -250..+250. Opening-line ROI +5.7% with all 3 open-odds seasons positive (2023-2025, CLV +3.96%, 71% positive-CLV bets); closing-line 12-season ROI +1.96%. Bets recorded in the morning sit between the open and close.

epl.note: Soccer v2 pooled top-5 walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_soccer_bets.py): market-aware calibrated home prob beats the devigged opening line by >= 4 pp raw (4.6 pp after 1.15x decorrelation), EV >= 5% — home outcomes only (draw/away legs were not profitable). Best-price execution ROI +4.3% across 2015-2025 with 10/11 seasons positive, CLV +4.0% (65% positive-CLV bets).
